registration.title: Pooling production with the Poisson model and the trees
registration.what: Combine the models' probabilities with weights chosen on development.
registration.why: Different models may make different mistakes.
registration.how: A log-linear pool, weights in steps of a tenth.
registration.hypothesis: A pool beats its best member.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The research round's bar (experiments/research_frame/REGISTER.md): better by 0.002 on the final period, the 99.6% interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by 0.0005, and 60% of competitions no worse.

events.label: Production and the Poisson model, final period
Production, the Poisson model and the trees, final period
events.meaningful: It meets the bar only because it is the trees with a tenth of production mixed in.

events.reason: Pooling adds nothing to the trees alone.
